notes: Products index is split across category pages: /products/endowment-plans, /retirement-annuity-plans, /legacy-planning, /protection, /riders. There is no single /products page (404).

Pages say products are distributed via the agency channel, bank partners and financial adviser partners; channel is marked mixed. Only the two DIRECT plans are sold directly by the insurer without advice.

Harvest Income, Lifetime Income and Eternal Wealth plans are described on their pages as participating whole life or legacy plans with lifetime yearly income; they are filed under whole_life although the site lists some under Retirement.
Three Harvest Income pages exist (Plan USD, Supreme USD, Supreme USD S2) and the Eternal Wealth USD/Supreme USD share one page; the Supreme USD page sits under the odd path /products/insurance/.
The home page links to /products/China-Life-Lifetime-Income-Plan-(RMB), which returns 404; omitted.
Rider pages live under /riders/ and have no PDF links; no rider PDFs were listed.
Multiplier Guardian Series and Multiplier Guardian Supreme are whole life plans with CI cover; filed as whole_life, not critical_illness.
Brochures for most plans do not state entry age or sum insured limits; facts are limited to what the page or brochure states.
